gloss: to watch; to view (a performance, show, or spectacle)

definitions.gloss: to watch; to view (a performance, film, show, or spectacle)
definitions.explanation: To watch something as a spectator, particularly performances, movies, plays, and other forms of entertainment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a drama on TV yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観|み}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: It was my first time watching kabuki, so I was very moved.

notes:
The kanji {観|み}る specifically refers to watching as a spectator — viewing performances, shows, films, and spectacles. While ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ is the general-purpose "to see/look at," {観|み}る implies appreciating or taking in something meant to be watched.

WRITING:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: general seeing, looking at anything
- {観|み}る: watching performances, shows, movies, spectacles
- ⟦{診|み}る→診る：09798_miru⟧: examining (medical)
- {視|み}る: inspecting, observing (formal)

In casual writing, ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ or hiragana みる is often used for all meanings. {観|み}る is preferred in more careful or literary writing when referring to entertainment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観|み}る: to watch a movie
- ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観|み}る: to watch a play
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観|み}る: to watch a game
- ⟦お{花見|はなみ}→お花見：17953_ohanami⟧: flower viewing (uses the same {観|み} concept)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see, to look at — the general-purpose verb; covers all types of seeing
- ⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appreciate (art, music) — more formal; emphasizes aesthetic appreciation
- ⟦{観覧|かんらん}→観覧：08382_kanran⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view, to watch — formal; used for exhibitions and public events
